# task\-dashboard\-commit\-guard — Guard dashboard git commit against blind git add \-A
status: todo  priority: 2  scope: scope-dashboard
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

From the 2026\-08\-15 complete code audit: POST /api/git/commit \(src/dashboard/server\.ts:579\-590\) runs \`git add \-A\` whenever the request has no \`files\`, and the Git page \(src/dashboard/client/src/pages/Git\.tsx:90\-112\) omits \`files\` when the user has not selected any\. One click on Commit can therefore stage and commit every change in the repo, including unrelated untracked files and the \.waystation ledger\. Fix: require an explicit file selection in the UI and reject file\-less commit requests server\-side \(or require an explicit \`addAll\` flag\)\.

## Acceptance
- POST /api/git/commit without \`files\` returns an error telling the user to select files \(or explicitly confirm add\-all\); it never silently stages everything\.
- The Git page Commit button is disabled or prompts when no files are selected\.
- Committing with explicit files behaves exactly as before\.
- All checks green: \`bun test\`, \`bun run typecheck\`, \`bun run check\`, \`waystation validate\`\.
